bindings.name: network_scope
bindings.description: Read the configured collector scope and probe limits.

bindings.name: network_scan
bindings.description: Request a scan through Relay using a caller-retained UUID. Admission is not completion.

bindings.name: network_scan_status
bindings.description: Read a manual request's local publication and collection receipts.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Canonical UUID of the retained request or scan.

bindings.name: network_scan_list
bindings.description: List the latest 50 local collection receipts.

bindings.name: network_evidence
bindings.description: Read a collection's observations, comparison, gaps and retained revision.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: Canonical UUID of the retained request or scan.

bindings.name: network_destinations
bindings.description: Read observed DNS destinations from a collection; queries do not prove transmitted content.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: Canonical UUID of the retained request or scan.

bindings.name: network_devices
bindings.description: List monitored devices with a confirmed MAC (offset/limit): device_id, name, address and attention signals. Follow next_offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page offset; follow the returned next_offset.

bindings.name: network_device
bindings.description: Read one monitored device's dossier: identity, open services, DNS purpose groups, traffic volume, coverage gaps and signals. Signals direct attention; they are not findings.

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: A device_id from network_devices: mac: and a canonical MAC address.
